description: Expose project-level AI quality metrics (first-time-right rate and per-stage rework rate over trailing 7d/30d windows) via a backend aggregation endpoint, and surface them in a QualityPanel mounted in the Dashboard Productivity slot.

tasks.title: Implement project-level AI quality aggregation endpoint
tasks.spec: specs/ai-quality-metrics/spec.md#Backend exposes a project-scoped AI quality aggregation endpoint with no new data collection
tasks.description: Add the backend quality aggregation following the approval-wait precedent. Create IssueQuerier.GetQualityAsync(projectId, now) that loads the project's issues plus their raw deserialized WorkflowRuns via a new sibling bulk loader LoadWorkflowRunsAsync (reusing DeserializeRun) so it can read StageCheck.RepairCount (dropped by WorkflowStatusMapper). Single-pass classify each shipped (Done) issue as first-time-right iff every check across all stage runs has RepairCount == 0, and record per-stage rework (at least one check in that stage with RepairCount > 0) over entered stages. Bucket each shipped issue into trailing 7d and 30d windows anchored on IssueEvents.Time of com.mohist.issue.work-completed. Add DTOs (QualityMetricsResponse / QualityMetricsWindowDto / StageReworkRateDto) with nullable rates + integer denominators for zero-sample distinguishability. Wire GET /api/projects/{projectRef}/issues/metrics/quality via a new IssueRoutes.QualityMetrics.cs partial mirroring ApprovalMetrics, returning both windows together. Cover classification, windowing, per-stage denominators, and zero-sample behavior with querier unit tests, and the endpoint contract (200 + both windows, empty result per window) with endpoint tests. No new event, column, or workflow write.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/projects/{projectRef}/issues/metrics/quality returns 200 with window7d and window30d, each carrying the first-time-right rate and the per-stage rework rates.
A shipped (Done) issue with every check RepairCount == 0 is classified first-time-right; any check with RepairCount > 0 makes it reworked.
Issues whose status is not Done are excluded from both the first-time-right numerator and denominator.

Each stage reports an independent rate using the set of shipped-in-window issues that entered that stage as its denominator; never-entered stages do not contribute to that stage's numerator or denominator.
7d and 30d windows are bucketed independently by ship (work-completed) event time; an issue shipped >30d ago is excluded from both windows.

A window with no shipped issues returns a nullable rate (not 0 and not 1) with SampleCount == 0, distinguishable from a genuine rate of 1.0 with SampleCount > 0; the two windows are evaluated for emptiness independently.
The aggregation computes purely from existing RepairCount and existing ship events — no new domain event, column, or workflow-domain write is introduced.
tasks.output: packages/server: IssueQuerier.GetQualityAsync + LoadWorkflowRunsAsync, quality metrics DTOs (IssueRoutes.Dtos.cs), IssueRoutes.QualityMetrics.cs partial + route wiring, plus querier unit tests and endpoint contract tests.
tasks.notes: Design decision D2 option B chosen: read raw WorkflowRun via a new bulk loader rather than widening CheckStatusView, to keep the data model concise. Design decision D3: anchor window membership on com.mohist.issue.work-completed event time (matching GetCompletionBucketsAsync), not WorkflowRun.CompletedAt.

tasks.title: Implement useQualityMetrics hook and QualityPanel component
tasks.spec: specs/dashboard-shell/spec.md#QualityPanel derives its quality rates exclusively from the server-side AI quality aggregation
tasks.description:
Add the data hook and rendering component for the ai-quality-metrics capability on the web. Create useQualityMetrics hook at entities/issue/api/quality-metrics.ts mirroring useApprovalWait (useProject -> useQuery with queryKey ['issues','metrics','quality',projectId], enabled when projectId present, staleTime 60_000), consuming the new quality endpoint; export it via the entities/issue/index.ts barrel. Build QualityPanel.tsx under pages/dashboard/productivity/ as a zero-arg component that calls the hook and renders the first-time-right rate and per-stage rework rates sourced exclusively from the endpoint (never computed client-side over the full run set). Branch on zero-sample (window sampleCount === 0, or per-stage enteredCount === 0) to the established empty-state convention (outer
+

) that is distinguishable from a genuine perfect score, mirroring CompletionTrend/InvestmentPanel. Include component rendering tests for populated and empty states.
acceptanceCriteria: useQualityMetrics queries GET /api/projects/{projectRef}/issues/metrics/quality, keyed by projectId, enabled only when projectId is present, with staleTime 60_000.
QualityPanel renders the first-time-right rate and per-stage rework rates sourced from the aggregation endpoint, not computed client-side over the local full set of workflow runs.

A zero-sample window (sampleCount === 0) renders a defined empty presentation (data-state="empty" with a productivity-quality-empty testid) distinguishable from a genuine first-time-right rate of 1.0.
A stage with enteredCount === 0 renders empty for that stage independently of other stages and of the overall window.
useQualityMetrics is exported via the entities/issue barrel.
Web typecheck passes (npm run typecheck -w packages/web) and web tests pass (npm run test:run -w packages/web).
tasks.output: packages/web: src/entities/issue/api/quality-metrics.ts + barrel export, src/pages/dashboard/productivity/QualityPanel.tsx, plus QualityPanel rendering tests (populated + empty).
tasks.notes: No invalidator helper is needed — this is a read-only trailing-window metric with no user action that invalidates it (same as useCompletionTrend). Loading state mirrors CompletionTrend (pending + empty treated identically) per design open question.

tasks.title: Mount QualityPanel in the Dashboard Productivity slot
tasks.spec: specs/dashboard-shell/spec.md#Dashboard provides four zone mount-point slots
tasks.description: Complete the dashboard-shell composition so the Productivity slot mounts the ai-quality-metrics zone content. Add <QualityPanel /> into ProductivityZone.tsx alongside CompletionTrend and InvestmentPanel. Wire the currently-dead-code ProductivityZone into DashboardPage.tsx's Productivity slot by changing the empty else-branch <DashboardZone> to <DashboardZone><ProductivityZone /></DashboardZone>, so the Productivity slot no longer renders as an empty placeholder. Flip the DashboardPage.test.tsx assertions that currently expect the productivity slot to be empty (productivity.childElementCount === 0 and productivity-zone absent) to expect it populated. Add a ProductivityZone composition test confirming QualityPanel mounts alongside its siblings.
acceptanceCriteria: ProductivityZone renders QualityPanel alongside CompletionTrend and InvestmentPanel.
DashboardPage renders ProductivityZone in the Productivity slot, so the Productivity slot no longer renders as an empty placeholder.
DashboardPage.test.tsx assertions are flipped: the Productivity slot has childElementCount > 0 and productivity-zone is present.
No Dashboard zone slot renders as an empty placeholder.
Web typecheck passes (npm run typecheck -w packages/web) and web tests pass (npm run test:run -w packages/web).
tasks.output: packages/web: src/pages/dashboard/productivity/ProductivityZone.tsx (mounts QualityPanel), src/pages/dashboard/DashboardPage.tsx (wires ProductivityZone into the slot), DashboardPage.test.tsx (flipped assertions), plus a ProductivityZone composition test.
tasks.notes: Revives the currently-dead-code ProductivityZone (defined but never imported). The proposal explicitly says 'alongside InvestmentPanel and CompletionTrend', which already live inside ProductivityZone, so reviving the zone is the intended composition rather than mounting QualityPanel directly into the slot.
